void ShiftRows(state_t *state) {
    // Row 0: no shift

    // Row 1: shift left by 1
    uint8_t temp = (*state)[1][0];
    (*state)[1][0] = (*state)[1][1];
    (*state)[1][1] = (*state)[1][2];
    (*state)[1][2] = (*state)[1][3];

    // Row 2: shift left by 2

    (*state)[2][2] = temp;

    temp = (*state)[2][1];
    (*state)[2][1] = (*state)[2][3];
    (*state)[2][3] = temp;

    // Row 3: shift left by 3 (equivalent to shift right by 1)
    temp = (*state)[3][3];
    (*state)[3][3] = (*state)[3][2];
    (*state)[3][2] = (*state)[3][1];
    (*state)[3][1] = (*state)[3][0];
